table.retrieve:
SELECT
	documentcode = A.documentcode,
	SaleType=A.SaleType,
	itemname=I.name,  
	itemalias=I.customicode,
	Packing=I.PackingDesc,
	GroupName= 
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	CustomerAlias=(Select Ac.AliasName FROM accounts Ac Where Ac.Acccode = A.CustCode),
	customer=(Select Ac.Name FROM accounts Ac Where Ac.Acccode = A.CustCode),
	/*Address=(Select RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address2)) FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),
	City=(Select C.CITY FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),*/
	Address=(Select RTRIM(LTRIM(isnull(C.Address1,''))) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(isnull(C.Address2,''))) FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),
	City=(Select isnull(C.CITY,'') FROM Customer C Where C.CustCode = A.CustCode),
	qty=Sum(A.qty),
	salebonusqty=Sum(A.salebonusqty),
	grossamount=SUM(A.grossamount),
	netamount=Sum(A.amount),
	Discount=Sum(A.Discount),
	cost = SUM(CASE A.SaleType WHEN 'S' THEN A.Cost ELSE - (A.Cost) END),
	Profit = Sum(CASE A.SaleType WHEN 'S' THEN A.amount - A.Cost ELSE A.Amount + A.Cost END),
	Stock=(select isnull(sum(godowndetail.currqty), 0) from godowndetail 
			where godowndetail.icode=I.icode and gcode IN 
				(select case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end from godown)),
	batch=a.batch,
	expiry=a.expiry,
	price=a.price,
	invcode=a.invcode,
	date=a.date,
	SalesMan = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode=A.SmanCode)
FROM
	Item I,
	(SELECT	
		documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), Saleledger.SaleInvCode))),
		SaleType='S',
		saleledger.date,
		saleledger.smancode,
		invcode=saleledger.saleinvcode,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		dbo.saledetail.icode,
		dbo.saledetail.batch,
		dbo.saledetail.expiry,
		price=MAX(dbo.saledetail.Saleprice),
		qty= Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		salebonusqty=sum(dbo.saledetail.bonusqty),
		grossamount=sum(saledetail.saleprice*saledetail.looseqty),
		amount   = Round(Sum ( saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail.discperc * 0.01)), 2),
		discount = Round(Sum ( saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (saledetail.discperc * 0.01)), 2),
		cost =  sum(dbo.saledetail.purunitrate * saledetail.looseqty)
	FROM 	dbo.saleledger, 
	 	dbo.saledetail, 
	 	dbo.item
	WHERE	dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ll_custcode) and
	 	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
	 	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode  AND
		dbo.saledetail.gcode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN dbo.saledetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end
	GROUP BY
		saleledger.saleinvcode,
		saleledger.date,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		saleledger.smancode,
		saledetail.icode,
		saledetail.batch,
		saledetail.expiry
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	
		documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), Saleledger.SaleInvCode))),
		SaleType='S',
		saleledger.date,
		saleledger.smancode,
		invcode=saleledger.saleinvcode,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		sd.icode,
		sd.batch,
		sd.expiry,
		price=MAX(sd.Saleprice),
		qty= Sum(sd.looseqty),
		salebonusqty=sum(sd.bonusqty),
		grossamount=sum(sd.saleprice*sd.looseqty),
		amount   = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01)), 2),
		discount = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * 0.01)), 2),
		cost = sum(sd.avgprice * sd.looseqty)
	FROM 	dbo.saleledger, 
	 	dbo.saleinvdetail sd, 
	 	dbo.item
	WHERE	dbo.saleledger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
		dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ll_custcode) and
	 	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
	 	sd.icode = item.icode  AND
		sd.gcode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end
	GROUP BY
		saleledger.saleinvcode,
		saleledger.date,
		dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		saleledger.smancode,
		sd.icode,
		sd.batch,
		sd.expiry
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	
		documentcode = 'SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SRledger.SRInvCode))),
		SaleType='R',
		srledger.date,
		srledger.smancode,
		invcode=srledger.srinvcode,
		dbo.srledger.custcode,
		dbo.srdetail.icode,
		dbo.srdetail.batch,
		dbo.srdetail.expiry,
		price=MAX(dbo.srdetail.SRPrice),
		qty= (-1 * Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty)),
		salebonusqty=(-1 * sum(dbo.srdetail.bonusqty)),
		grossamount=(-1*(sum(srdetail.srprice*srdetail.looseqty))),
		amount   = (-1 * Round(Sum ( srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice * (1 - srdetail.discperc * 0.01) ), 2)),
		amount   = (-1 * Round(Sum ( srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice * (srdetail.discperc * 0.01) ), 2)),
		cost = sum(dbo.srdetail.avgprice * srdetail.looseqty)
	FROM
		dbo.srledger, 
		dbo.srdetail,    
		dbo.item
	WHERE
		dbo.srledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	 	dbo.srledger.custcode IN (:ll_custcode) and
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN dbo.item.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN dbo.item.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN dbo.item.ICCode
		ELSE dbo.item.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) and
		dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode AND
		dbo.srdetail.gcode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN dbo.srdetail.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode end
	GROUP BY 
		srledger.srinvcode,
		srledger.date,
		srledger.custcode,
		srledger.smancode,
		srdetail.icode,
		srdetail.batch,
		srdetail.expiry) AS A
WHERE
	A.icode = I.icode
GROUP BY 	
	A.Documentcode,
	A.SaleType,
	A.invcode,
	A.Date,
	A.CustCode,
	A.SManCode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	I.name,
	I.customicode,
	I.PackingDesc,
	I.Icode,
	A.Batch,
	A.Expiry,
	A.Price
ORDER BY
	Customer,
	GroupName,
	SaleType,
	InvCode,
	itemname,
	Packing,
	Batch,
	Expiry
table.sort: customer A, groupname A, invcode A, itemname A, packing A, batch A, expiry A
